info.name: Public API Reference Certificates Product / Styles API

params.name: level
params.description: Controls which tier of the product hierarchy is returned. 'style' = top-level product (no parent ID required). 'variant' = colour or variant (requires styleId). 'sku' = size or SKU (requires variantId). The updatedAfterUnixMs filter is supported at all three levels.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number (1-based). Defaults to 1. Check metadata.pagination.totalPages in the response to know if more pages exist.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results per page (1–100). Defaults to 20. Check metadata.pagination.totalPages in the response to know if more pages exist.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by product name (partial match).

params.name: codeId
params.description: Filter by code type/ID, e.g. ERP_ID. Combine with codeValue.

params.name: codeValue
params.description: Filter by code value, e.g. DRS-001. Combine with codeId.

params.name: styleTypeId
params.description: Filter by style type ID.

params.name: styleLevelId
params.description: Filter by style level ID.

params.name: brands
params.description: Comma-separated list of brand IDs to filter by.

params.name: departments
params.description: Comma-separated list of department IDs to filter by.

params.name: seasons
params.description: Comma-separated list of season IDs to filter by.

params.name: collections
params.description: Comma-separated list of collection IDs to filter by.

params.name: suppliers
params.description: Comma-separated list of supplier IDs to filter by.

params.name: vendors
params.description: Comma-separated list of vendor IDs to filter by.

params.name: mainSupplier
params.description: Filter by main supplier ID.

params.name: isComponent
params.description: Filter by component / raw material flag. Accepts true or false.

params.name: isStoryActive
params.description: Filter by traceability page status. Accepts true or false.

params.name: isArchived
params.description: Filter by archived status. Defaults to false.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated list of related data to include, e.g. 'codes,brands'.

params.name: nameOrCode
params.description: Optional. Filter styles by name or external code value (partial match). Use to look up a specific product by its ERP ID, PLM ID, or display name.

params.name: description
params.description: Filter by description (partial match).

params.name: gender
params.description: Filter by gender (e.g. MALE, FEMALE, UNISEX).

params.name: createdForMe
params.description: Filter to products created for your company.

params.name: isCreatedForNetwork
params.description: Filter to products created for your network.

params.name: companyId
params.description: Filter by owning company ID.

params.name: certValidationStandardId
params.description: Filter by certification validation standard ID.

params.name: certValidationExpirationDate
params.description: Filter by certification expiration date.

params.name: certValidationIssueDate
params.description: Filter by certification issue date.

params.name: color
params.description: Filter variants by color. Only applicable when level=variant.

params.name: styleId
params.description: Filter variants by parent style ID. Only applicable when level=variant.

params.name: variantId
params.description: Filter SKUs by parent variant ID. Only applicable when level=sku.

params.name: dimension
params.description: Filter SKUs by dimension. Only applicable when level=sku.

params.name: updatedAfterUnixMs
params.description: Optional. Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Returns only styles modified after this point in time. Use for incremental sync — on subsequent calls pass the timestamp of your last successful pull.

params.name: updatedBeforeUnixMs
params.description: Return products updated before this Unix timestamp (milliseconds).

items.docs: GET /styles serves all three tiers of the product hierarchy from a single endpoint, controlled by the required `level` query parameter. At `level=style` the endpoint returns top-level products and accepts optional filters (nameOrCode, updatedAfterUnixMs, page, pageSize). At `level=variant` a `styleId` is required and results are scoped to colour/variant children of that style. At `level=sku` a `variantId` is required and results are scoped to size/SKU children of that variant. Paginate using the

Create a style, variant, or SKU. Omit parentId to create a top-level style. Set parentId to a style ID to create a variant, or to a variant ID to create a SKU. styleTypeId and isComponent are required when creating a top-level style.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the style, variant, or SKU.

items.docs: Retrieve a single style, variant, or SKU by ID. The product level is resolved automatically from the ID.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the style, variant, or SKU.

items.docs: Update a style, variant, or SKU by ID. The product level is resolved automatically from the ID. All body fields are optional — only provided fields will be updated.
Archive one or more styles, variants, or SKUs. All IDs must belong to the same product level. Archiving a style cascades to all its child variants and SKUs.
Unarchive one or more styles, variants, or SKUs. All IDs must belong to the same product level.
